title: WF03 IDN-01 release NFR-02 throughput blocker: benchmark append path dominated by per-row protocol overhead

root_cause.description: The NFR-02 throughput benchmark used one parameterized INSERT round-trip per event inside the timed loop, so client wire-protocol and parse/bind/execute overhead dominated measurement and produced an artificial throughput shortfall unrelated to IDN-01 functional logic.

resolution.summary: Updated throughput measurement in tests/bench/bench.zig to batch appends using a single parameterized INSERT..SELECT generate_series call per iteration while keeping transaction boundaries and payload semantics unchanged.

actions: Avoid per-event network round-trips in throughput benchmarks when the objective is datastore sustained append capacity.
Prefer parameterized batched INSERT strategies in benchmark hot loops to reduce harness overhead distortion.
Keep benchmark output as structured NFR_RESULT lines so release validation can reliably gate on measured values.
